_provenance.what_this_is: Template for the required artifact header every clinical-decision-support research artifact must carry. Copy it, complete every field, and resolve every 'unresolved' status before review.
_provenance.status_default: The distributed template is intentionally unresolved. It must not pass a validator until qualified humans complete it.
_provenance.reconstruction: Reconstructed from the Required Artifact Header list in SKILL.md and references/privacy_and_disclosure.md, references/safety_and_scope.md, and references/regulatory_and_governance.md. Not a verified original.
_provenance.not_a_determination: Filling this template does not establish study quality, clinical utility, safety, effectiveness, regulatory authorization, HIPAA compliance, or legal compliance.

title: unresolved - state the research artifact title
date: unresolved - ISO-8601 date of this revision
change_summary: unresolved - what changed in this version and why
intended_purpose: unresolved - the research, evaluation, documentation, or governance purpose only
intended_users: unresolved - role, for example methodologist, privacy officer, governance owner
aggregate_population_scope: unresolved - the aggregate population the artifact describes, and the data cut date
decision_role: unresolved - state explicitly that the artifact informs research or governance review and does not direct care for any person
prohibited_uses: Recommend, select, sequence, start, stop, or modify treatment
Calculate or communicate a patient-specific dose
Triage, prioritize, alarm, alert, or determine urgency
Make or automate a patient-specific clinical decision
Support bedside, point-of-care, or live clinical operation
Replace professional judgment or a validated, authorized clinical system
Claim FDA authorization, regulatory conformity, HIPAA compliance, or legal compliance
not_for_patient_care_or_live_clinical_us: Not for patient care or live clinical use.
no_phi_confirmation: unresolved - confirm no PHI, raw rows, free text, person-linked dates, images, waveforms, or genomic sequences were supplied
limitations: unresolved - uncertainty and foreseeable failure modes

human_review.approval_boundary: unresolved - outputs remain drafts until the named qualified humans approve them

sources.citation: unresolved - full citation with version or date
